summary: CMO Executive Authorization & Go-To-Market Master Directive for the 65W GaN USB-C Charger launch across Vietnamese ecommerce platforms (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop). Consolidates and validates specialist outputs across Intelligence, Strategy, Creative, and Performance into an integrated, evidence-grounded launch roadmap under SUPERVISED autonomy mode. Authorizes Phase 1 pilot testing budget of 20,000,000 VND, enforces strict laptop compatibility disclaimers to prevent return spikes, and establishes unambiguous stop-loss guardrails (Max Blended CPA 120,000 VND; Return Rate <= 3.5%; Min ROAS 3.5x).

details.commercial_objective: Establish a top-3 contender position in the Vietnam marketplace 65W GaN category within 90 days, maintaining positive first-order contribution margin (target 75,000 VND/unit) while securing >4.8-star review velocity.

autonomy_and_governance_tier.governance_rule: Internal strategy, creative asset rendering, and tracking taxonomies are fully approved; live ad spend deployment and marketplace store mutations require explicit Human Operator sign-off via ApprovalRequestCard.

verified_facts: GaN semiconductor architecture delivering 65W maximum output via USB-C Power Delivery standard.
Compact form factor significantly smaller than standard 350g OEM silicon charging bricks.
Vietnam marketplace benchmark corridor for 65W GaN chargers is 300,000 to 700,000 VND.
strictly_enforced_claim_guardrails: Laptop compatibility must strictly be qualified as 'Dành cho các dòng laptop và thiết bị hỗ trợ chuẩn Type-C Power Delivery (13-14 inch MacBook Air/Pro, Dell XPS, ThinkPad)'.
Universal compatibility claims for gaming laptops (>100W) or proprietary non-PD connectors are strictly prohibited across all ad copy and PDP descriptions.
Thermal safety claims must reference verified GaN semiconductor efficiency rather than unverified internal laboratory temperature readings pending engineering test reports.

commercial_positioning_and_offer_archite.positioning_theme: 'Một Củ Sạc Cho Tất Cả' — Everyday Carry (EDC) Tech & Desk Decluttering Tool replacing bulky factory chargers.
commercial_positioning_and_offer_archite.target_audience: Urban office workers and remote professionals (Ages 22–35, Hanoi & HCMC) commuting with USB-C PD ultrabooks.
value_proposition_anchors: Size & Weight Reduction: ~100g compact GaN charger vs. 350g+ legacy power brick.
Hardware Safety Assurance: 12-Month 1-to-1 direct replacement warranty policy disarming local tech forum anxieties regarding voltage surges.
Stability: Balanced center-of-gravity engineered for snug fit in standard Vietnamese 2-pin round wall sockets.

phase_1_calibration_days_1_to_14.objective: Execute A/B creative hypothesis validation (EXP-GAN65-VN-001) and calibrate channel CPA baselines.
phase_1_calibration_days_1_to_14.primary_deliverable: Validate Angle 01 (Kitchen Scale Weight Contrast) against Generic GaN Speed hook.

phase_2_scale_days_15_to_30.objective: Scale winning creative assets to 80% ad budget allocation, activate creator affiliate seeding, and expand high-intent keyword capture.
phase_2_scale_days_15_to_30.scaling_prerequisites: Phase 1 blended CPA <= 120,000 VND, ROAS >= 4.0x, and 14-day trailing return rate <= 3.0%.

experimentation_and_measurement_governan.experiment_title: Everyday Carry Dual Replacement Hook vs Generic GaN Speed Hook
experimentation_and_measurement_governan.primary_metric: Direct SKU Purchase CVR (%) on Shopee Search Ads
experimentation_and_measurement_governan.decision_rule: Scale Variant B if CVR lift >= 15% with 90% confidence bounds; declare inconclusive if delta < 8% after 1,200 clicks per arm and rotate to Angle 02 (Socket Stability).
experimentation_and_measurement_governan.early_termination_trigger: Halt variant immediately if ROAS drops below 3.5x over a 48-hour trailing window with >= 200 clicks.

risk_management_and_contingency_matrix.risk_scenario: Blended CPA exceeds 120,000 VND cap during initial 7-day launch.
risk_management_and_contingency_matrix.root_cause_hypothesis: Shopee keyword bidding competition against Baseus/Ugreen inflating CPC.
risk_management_and_contingency_matrix.mandatory_mitigation: Immediately pause high-bid broad keywords; shift 40% of demand capture budget into TikTok Shop creator affiliate video ads and optimize PDP carousel trust badges.

risk_management_and_contingency_matrix.risk_scenario: Return/Refund rate exceeds 3.5% citing 'Incompatible with laptop'.
risk_management_and_contingency_matrix.root_cause_hypothesis: Consumers purchasing charger for non-PD or high-wattage gaming rigs.
risk_management_and_contingency_matrix.mandatory_mitigation: Update PDP Hero Slide 2 with explicit red/green compatibility chart; add pre-dispatch customer service auto-confirmation message verifying laptop model.

risk_management_and_contingency_matrix.risk_scenario: Loose socket wobble reported in customer reviews.
risk_management_and_contingency_matrix.root_cause_hypothesis: Worn wall sockets in older coffee shops.
risk_management_and_contingency_matrix.mandatory_mitigation: Deploy Angle 02 creative assets showcasing horizontal multi-plug adapter recommendations and pin stability guarantees.

human_approval_gate_requests.description: Authorize initial Phase 1 ad spend disbursement across Shopee Ads, Lazada Sponsored Solutions, and TikTok Shop.
Approve publishing of 4-slide Shopee/Lazada PDP carousel, Vietnamese product descriptions, and 12-month replacement warranty badges.
